March12,1857, fourteen full blocks, five notes, complete annotations and bibliography read. Missing new Darwin letter acknowledged; explicitly retreats from prior duck-mediated crustacean certainty to common report, doubts ova survive gizzard, promises precise evidence. This is no definitive experiment or disproof. Anas maxima example combines sister’s1848 storm bird with recent friend-reported specimens; possible hybrid identification and alleged death cause remain attributed, not proven physiology. Seeds going uphill in cattle dung differ from river downstream transport; Spanish introductions and essential-germination claims are Hill reports/hypotheses. Mullets taking seeds not evidence seeds survived fish digestion. Whistling-duck breeding observed, Palamedea rearing/pairing not proven breeding, parrot negative report and quail enclosure/blindness claims bounded. Later promises not delivered. Raw43o degree and vegeation/other spelling artifacts require supported rendering. Undated Darwin annotation expressly says ducks carrying eggs not known.

reading_method: Root independently read complete surviving new source bodies, metadata constraints, exclusions, footnotes, scholarly sections and bibliography. Actual special markup and figures inspected where present. Reused explicit accepted primary readings only after matching source and accepted evidence hashes. Historical decisions and notes are handwritten; validation packages evidence rather than adjudicating it.
